school: 文艺复兴全才 polymath/画家（蒙娜丽莎、最后的晚餐）/解剖学家/工程师与飞行器概念设计者/透视与光学研究者/观察-素描-验证方法的实践者
historical_significance: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇（1452-1519），生于意大利托斯卡纳芬奇镇，佛罗伦萨韦罗基奥工坊出师，是文艺复兴最典型的 polymath。绘画方面存世代表作《蒙娜丽莎》与《最后的晚餐》，以晕涂法（sfumato）和精确的透视、解剖结构重塑西方绘画。他留下约7000页手稿，镜像书写，内容横跨解剖学（亲手解剖约30具尸体，绘制骨骼肌肉心脏研究图）、水力学、机械设计、飞行器（扑翼机、螺旋飞行器）与坦克概念设计。他主张'体验是一切可靠知识之母'，坚持观察先于权威、解剖先于成说、实验先于推论，把艺术实践建立在光学、几何与解剖的科学根基之上。晚年应弗朗索瓦一世之邀居法国昂布瓦兹，1519年逝世。
historical_significance_en: Leonardo da Vinci (1452-1519), born in Vinci, Tuscany, trained in Verrocchio's Florentine workshop, is the archetypal Renaissance polymath. His surviving masterpieces, the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper, remade Western painting through sfumato and precise perspective and anatomy. Some 7,000 pages of mirrored manuscript survive, spanning anatomy (dissecting some 30 corpses himself, drawing bone, muscle and heart studies), hydraulics, mechanical design, flying machines (ornithopter, aerial screw) and tank concepts. He held that 'experience is the mother of all certainty', insisting on observation before authority, dissection before doctrine, experiment before inference, and grounding artistic practice in optics, geometry and anatomy. He died in 1519 at Amboise under the patronage of Francis I.
description_zh: 文艺复兴 polymath 的思维原型：以观察取代权威，以解剖还原机制，以几何约束空间，以跨域类比联通万物，以手稿并行推进永不完结的探究。
description_en: The prototype of the Renaissance polymath mind: observation over authority, dissection over doctrine, geometry over appearance, cross-domain analogy over silos, and an endless manuscript-driven inquiry.
